body:
Renewed independent exact-head review accepts corrected b82ee after the prior fcf acceptance was withdrawn for missing tracked module custody. The five full original modules are now independently verified as committed archives and the supported reader passed in a clean tracked-only fixture; missing/corrupt module controls reject. The earlier review and blocking correction remain history. This accepts the unactivated shared batch with the limits below. I independently rederived all thirteen source decisions, verified the two complete output sets and original custody, and ran the actual bounded125-row draw/pick/conservation test. This is a reusable batch path with134 proposed cells, not physical authority, activation or global completion. Normal CI/queue and strict successor rebind remain required.
